name: Akan
overview: The topic of Akan, also referred to as Jakan, Jaakan, or Jaakan in Scripture, is connected to the descendants of Ezer, a Horite lineage. Genesis 36:27 and 1 Chronicles 1:42 identify Akan as one of Ezer's sons, highlighting the variant spellings of the name. Deuteronomy 10:6 mentions the children of Jaakan in the context of Israel's journey, marking a geographical and historical reference point where Aaron died and was buried. These passages collectively affirm Akan's identity within the genealogical and historical framework of Israel's early narrative.
